description: This file contains implementation of a transformer-based language model, including classes for model configuration, attention mechanisms, transformer blocks, and utility functions for rotary embeddings and cache management.

classes.name: ModelArgs
classes.description: Data class for storing transformer model configuration parameters.

classes.name: KVCache
classes.description: Buffer class for caching key and value tensors during transformer inference.

classes.name: Transformer
classes.description: Main transformer model class combining embedding, multiple layers, normalization, and output projection.

classes.name: TransformerBlock
classes.description: A single transformer block consisting of attention and feed-forward sublayers.

classes.name: Attention
classes.description: Multi-head self-attention mechanism with rotary embeddings and cache support.

classes.name: FeedForward
classes.description: Position-wise feed-forward network used within transformer blocks.

methods.name: find_multiple
methods.description: Utility function to find the smallest multiple of k greater than or equal to n.

methods.name: from_name
methods.description: Class method to instantiate ModelArgs from a model name or configuration.

methods.name: setup_caches
methods.description: Initializes cache buffers and precomputes rotary frequencies for inference.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs a forward pass through the transformer model.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates key and value caches at specified positions.

methods.name: apply_rotary_emb
methods.description: Applies rotary positional embeddings to query and key tensors.

methods.name: precompute_freqs_cis
methods.description: Precomputes frequency and complex exponential tensors for rotary embeddings.
